title: Multi-axis weight-programmed knowledge frontier: arity, information, transfer, memory, repair, and whole-process cost
hypothesis: With a known generic Boolean evaluator and observed input/output rows, full-table knowledge can be directly stored in numeric weights for previously unspecified Boolean functions of arity 2, 3 and 4, survive cold restoration, compose in new DAGs, and admit isolated repairs. With uniformly arbitrary rules and only half the rows, no method without extra prior information can reliably infer the unseen rows. Direct weight writing must be compared against a fully converged matched-information gradient learner AND a simpler exact table-memory baseline, including all-in cost.

regimes.scoring: all 2^(arity+1) inputs per world; all 2^arity rows for each gate
regimes.source_generation: SHA256('WSP37-V1|cohort|arity|kind|world|gate') with distinct cohort names, zero filtering; each arity/rule class isolated
regimes.rule_definitions: arbitrary: uniform digest bits over the complete 2^arity-entry truth-table space; structured: deterministic parity/threshold/multiplexer family with source spec, learning arms not given hidden family choice
regimes.topology: forward-only DAG, deterministic SHA256 route choices; final gate mixes previous gates
regimes.heldout: PRIMARY corpus generated only by frozen code after prereg commit, no tuning on PRIMARY

measurements: OOD transfer to independently generated DAG with acquired gate functions but unseen topology
one-row causal repair with unaffected gates preserved
whole-process observations, compile/fit, restore and inference wall time separately; serialized bytes
arms: direct_weight_write with zeros for unobserved slots
gradient-trained per-gate converged sigmoid/BCE using identical observations; unseen logits initialized 0
literal_table_memory using identical observations, default 0 for unobserved
controls: half-probe shuffled row order checked deterministically
strong literal table baseline expected to equal or outperform direct writing
frozen irrelevant-gate repair and true single-row mutation
training convergence checked on every observed label

thresholds.engineering: all guardrails true, no leaked source rules or evaluator target labels, 0 failed tests across Windows/Linux
thresholds.scientific_positive: primary direct full-rule >= 0.99 on primitive and composed outputs in all six regimes; cold and repair parity 1.0; half arbitrary unseen must remain between 0.42 and 0.58 aggregate. Scientific superiority requires direct result strictly above both conventional gradient and literal-table comparator under matched observations plus lower measured end-to-end cost in both OS, not just zero gradient count.
thresholds.mixed: engineering pass but partial accuracy/cost margins fail scientific positive, or primary metrics differ across OS despite valid output
thresholds.negative: engineering-valid primary without measured accuracy/cost superiority over both strongest controls; preserve all failures
thresholds.invalid: hidden input leakage, changed prereg after first primary, nonmatched information, unexpected source drift, unqualified run, or ineffective negative controls

limits.primary_allowed: frozen synthetic public contribution after prereg, not independent official science acceptance
limits.scope: isolated successor of WSP36, no merge/promote/main, no official Yggdrasil/FORGE or private executor
limits.budget: pure Python standard-library, no paid API, hosted existing Windows+Linux CI; development must remain well within 30-minute job cap
limits.scientific_caveat: This does not test autonomous acquisition of world knowledge, text semantics, fully trained large models, or general reasoning; fixed topology is provided and source truth row queries are privileged.
